text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I accompanied Still in Love to a 
magazine interview. The topic was her 
racing outfit—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
A subdued atmosphere, yet somehow full of 
passion—that's what this outfit feels 
like. How did you arrive at this design?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Umm... Yes, well――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
When I first thought about the design... I 
already had an ideal image in mind.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Being quiet and reserved... That was what 
made me feel like "myself," and it brought 
me peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love gazes off into the distance. 
I, too, find my thoughts drifting back to 
our conversation back then.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um... I am terribly sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the questionnaire for the racing 
silks design... Could you spare me a 
little more time, please?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I will make sure it's done by the 
deadline, without fail... I am so sorry 
for causing you trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Another day.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... No good... I just can't get it 
out of my head...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—I-I'm so sorry...! I'll try to get it out 
as soon as possible...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love seemed deeply troubled by 
the design of her racewear. It was as if 
something was holding her back, keeping 
her from taking that next step...
choice_data_list: (She looks like she's in a bit of pain...)
(She looks like she's in a bit of pain...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, while walking along the 
riverbank, I spotted Still in Love holding 
a notebook.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Why...? A design like this... isn't like 
me at all...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Tr-Trainer...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled, the notebook slips from Still in 
Love's hands. What is drawn on the open 
page leaps into my sight.
choice_data_list: Is this... a racing outfit design?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That racing outfit was an eye-catching 
crimson, with a bold and revealing design. 
Almost the exact opposite of what she was 
wearing right now...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Um... to be precise, it wasn't me, 
but the "other me"... but still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Every time I think about the design... it 
whispers to me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"That's not enough— Lay yourself bare, 
more and more"... she said.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am... against that design. An appearance 
so... "scandalous"...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
And yet... no matter how many times I try 
to shake it off, I can't get it out of my 
head...
choice_data_list:
Is there anything about her that draws you 
in?

Is there something about her that you find 
appealing?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps, you're right... But as things 
stand right now... there's just no way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has doubts about a design 
that's merely understated. If so—
choice_data_list:
Maybe you don't have to take in 
everything?

You don't have to take everything in, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
Why not design an outfit that stays true 
to both sides of you?

Why not design an outfit that stays true 
to both sides of you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: An outfit... free of falsehood...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I still think that's far too reckless. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
Obey my voice. Deep down, isn't this what 
you truly desire as well?

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
Running, competing, devouring one 
another... I'll need to wear an outfit 
worthy of such a feast of madness.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: So... hey, can I have it?

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
"The 'flesh' to feel the wind... The 
'crimson' to set the blood boiling—!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It really is shameless. An outfit that 
bared everything just for the sake of 
pleasure...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't deny everything about 
you... It's also true that there's 
something captivating about you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Above all else... she told me. She told me 
to make sure neither version of me is a 
lie...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: So, let's talk this out.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To create the one and only Racewear— just 
for *us*.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Using a calm, understated silhouette as 
the base, with crimson as the core 
color... I tried incorporating just a 
touch of 'boldness.'"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The quiet me, and the me yearning for 
impulse— I listen to both of their 
voices...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So whenever I slip my arms into this 
outfit... I genuinely feel 'good' about 
it, and it makes me stand tall and proud.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's a racing outfit true to myself— 
without lying to either side of who I am.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she finished speaking, she suddenly 
turned her gaze toward me. As if answering 
that look, I quietly opened my mouth.
choice_data_list: That racing outfit really suits you.
I'm glad we could listen to both sides.
I'm glad we could listen to both sides.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she finished speaking, she suddenly 
turned her gaze toward me. As if answering 
that look, I quietly opened my mouth.
choice_data_list: That racing outfit really suits you.
I'm glad we could listen to both sides.
I'm glad we could listen to both sides.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words carried a hint of shyness, along 
with a tiny touch of pride.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't told me... I think it would 
have been difficult.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I am grateful. Both myself... and "her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up feeling embarrassed by her 
words and quietly looked away.
